app.local: Your data stays on this computer.

lock.createIntro: Your data will stay on this computer, encrypted. The key that opens it is kept by the study's Combray server, which only hands it back for your password and never sees your data. Choose a password you will remember: if it is forgotten, nobody can open the data again, not even the researchers. You can always add your data again.
lock.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same yet.
lock.unlockIntro: Type your password to open your data on this computer.
lock.wrong: That password does not open this space. Shall we try again?
lock.wait_one: That was a few tries in a row, so let's pause for a moment. You can try again in {{count}} minute.
lock.wait_other: That was a few tries in a row, so let's pause for a moment. You can try again in {{count}} minutes.
lock.unreachable: We could not reach the Combray server just now. Your data is safe on this computer. Is it connected to the internet? Please try again in a moment.
lock.storeGone: The key for this space no longer exists, so its data cannot be opened anymore. You can start over below and add your data again.
lock.confirmDelete: This deletes everything you added for this study on this computer. It cannot be undone. Continue?
lock.autoLocked: We locked your data because Combray was not used for a while.
lock.deleteAll: Delete everything for this study from this computer
lock.invalidParticipant: This personal link does not seem quite right. Could you check it with the researchers?
lock.resetIntro: The researchers sent you this link so you can choose a new password. Your data on this computer stays as it was.
lock.resetInvalid: This link has already been used or has expired. Please ask the researchers for a new one.
lock.askReset: Forgot the password? The researchers can send you a link to choose a new one. Or:

home.title: Your memories
home.empty: Nothing here yet. Shall we fetch your first memories?

import.title: Add your data
import.intro: Choose the zip file you downloaded from a platform (such as Google Takeout or TikTok), a folder, or single files. Everything is read and kept on this computer only.
import.failed: Something went wrong while reading this. Nothing was stored.

step.importers: Looking for familiar things in it…

datasets.nothingFound: We did not recognise anything in this yet, but you can still browse everything.

explore.shapeIntro: This is the structure of your data without any of its content: the names of files and fields, what kind of value each one holds, and roughly how many there are. Names that look like personal details are replaced, for example by <email> or <date>. Only this kind of information could ever be shared to help researchers, and only if you agree.

views.noDates: There are no dates in this data.
views.timelineCaption: How many items there are per {{unit}}. The highest bar is {{max}}. Choose a bar to see those memories.

projects.title: Your studies on this computer
projects.empty: There is nothing here yet. To take part in a study, open the link you received from the researchers.
projects.all: See your studies on this computer

not-found.title: We could not find this study
not-found.text: Please check the link you received from the researchers.

unreachable.title: We could not reach Combray
unreachable.text: Is this computer connected to the internet? Please try again in a moment.

needs-id.title: This study uses personal links
needs-id.text: Please open the personal link you received from the researchers, so your data is kept for you.

reset-no-store.title: Open this link on your own computer
reset-no-store.text: This link lets you choose a new password for data you added before, on another computer. Please open it on the computer where you added your data.

studio.title: Researcher workspace
studio.intro: Load your own export from a platform, decide what happens to each part of it, and see what participants will see. Your export stays in this tab: it is not stored and not sent anywhere. Only the structure and your decisions are kept in this browser as a draft.
studio.exportsIntro: Add your own or a synthetic export. You can add several, for example in different languages; their structure is combined.
studio.filesIntro: Save your work as structure.json and importer.json, or open files saved earlier or shared by another project.
studio.confirmStartOver: This clears the structure and all decisions in this workspace. Have you saved your files? Continue?
studio.started: Here is the structure of your export, with a table for every list. Everything starts undecided, which participants see but are not asked to donate.
studio.opened_one: Opened. {{count}} setting is waiting for a path that is not in the structure yet.
studio.opened_other: Opened. {{count}} settings are waiting for paths that are not in the structure yet.
studio.openFailed: These files could not be opened: {{reason}}
studio.pending_one: {{count}} setting waits for a path no export has shown yet. It is kept and saved.
studio.pending_other: {{count}} settings wait for paths no export has shown yet. They are kept and saved.
studio.onlyUndecided: Only show what is still undecided
studio.selectHelp: Choose a name in the tree to give it a label, a description or aliases.
studio.leafHelp: A field. Choose whether participants see it, are asked to donate it, or whether it is ignored.
studio.innerHelp: A group of fields. Ignoring it ignores everything inside.
studio.label: Label
studio.descriptionHelp: One sentence, used when we ask for this field, for example “the time you watched each video”.
studio.raw: Donate the value as it is in the file, not converted
studio.aliasesHelp: Other names that mean the same, such as a translation (kijkgeschiedenis.json) or a renamed key. Use * as a wildcard.
studio.badRegex: That is not a valid regular expression.
studio.mergeHelp: If this is the same as another part next to it, merge it: its name becomes an alias and what is inside is combined.
studio.merged_one: Merged. {{count}} setting differed on both sides; the one you merged into was kept.
studio.merged_other: Merged. {{count}} settings differed on both sides; the ones you merged into were kept.
studio.previewIntro: The tables participants will see with your current decisions, filled with your own export.
studio.previewEmpty: Add an export to see the preview.
studio.noTables: With these decisions, participants would see nothing yet.
studio.tableHelp: The entries of this become the rows of a table. Its label is the table's name. Tables inside its rows show up as a number participants can open.
studio.keysHelp: Are the keys here data rather than names of fields, such as the people who replied or the days of a diary? Then each key becomes a row, with the key and its value as columns.
studio.keysAreData: The keys here are data: each key is a row of a table with a key and a value column.
studio.keysDecisionHelp: The decision here is about the keys themselves, such as the names of the people who replied.
studio.confirmKeys: All keys here become one position, and their names are not kept, because they are data. Decisions that differ between them are listed afterwards. Continue?
studio.recordTable: Fields that are not part of a list
studio.undecidedOnly: Only fields that are still undecided
studio.shortcuts: Keys on a selected row: 1 undecided, 2 ignore, 3 show, 4 donate.

viewHelp.fields: Only tables and the fields in them, named as their columns. Hover a field to see where it is in the file.
viewHelp.tree: Everything in the files, including the folders, objects and HTML in between.

studio.chartIntro: Count rows over time or per value, from the exports you loaded. This runs in your browser; it is a first step towards views participants can make themselves.

chart.empty: Nothing to draw yet: no rows have a value here.
chart.explore: Chart values; use the arrow keys to move along the timeline
chart.failed: This chart could not be made from these exports.
